notes.title: Update 28.8.2018: New Countries, Arenas and Graphical improvements
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32270245/2f999fc0e2656cd24497da8f986e7c68a2fdb07e.png[/img]

[b]MAJOR UPDATE[/b]
[h1]New Countries, Arenas and Graphical improvements[/h1]

Today we announce huge update to Seasonal Soccer. This [b]"Moscow Update"[/b] brings new levels to the game and possibility to choose new countries.

The following fixes, improvements and updates are now included:

[list]
    [*]New, better music
    [*]HIGHER screen resolution
    [*]8 min Half-Time and 8 min Full-Time, so completing first match will take 16 minutes and now you have time to enjoy the game
    [*]If you look screenshots you can find that something new has appeared to the arena. Next updates will bring "living audience" to the arenas.
    [*]NEW LEVEL! Moscow.
    [*]NEW countries: France, England, Russia and Belgium. (You can choose these new countries after completing first arena).
[/list]

We have divided first match to two parts, because a standard football match consists of two halves of 45 minutes each. Each half runs continuously, meaning that the clock is not stopped when the ball is out of play. There is usually a 15-minute half-time break between halves. The end of the match is known as full-time.

notes.title: Update 17.8.2018: Full Screen mode and menu bar
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32270245/7a55d6866c14f39bf2c37eda9092bc010859231e.png[/img]

[h1] Full screen is now enabled and other improvements have been added[/h1]

Today's update brings new improvements to the game.

[b]Full Screen -mode:[/b]
You can choose from 4 different screen size: 320x240, 640x480, 800x600 and Full Screen! (New!). Full Screen mode is still experimental and it is possible that while playing in full screen mode, you might not see incredible graphics frames which appear when you or opponent team made a goal.

[b]Menu bar[/b]
You can now easily adjust game settings from the menu bar (Pause, FullScreen etc).

notes.title: Update 11.8.2018: Improvements
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32270245/dd66c80455f0d7f4f26c9ce2d7d05edc219fdc15.png[/img]

[b]It is time for a update![/b]

[h1] Update 11.8.2018: Improvements [/h1]

This update 8102811954 brings:

[list]
   [*]new background pictures to the menu screens
   [*]improvements to the sounds/music on the menu 
   [*]fixes to sound volume; sound volume is not now so high on the menu 
   [*]fixes to sound volume; football arena audience wont stop encourages the 
   team! (longer sound track)
[/list]

In previous versions, the music might been too loud in the game's menu. We have fixed this now and music should now be on the right frequency!

(Note: Of course you can adjust the music from your sound source as in any game. Situation about that music track was that the default settings was too loud. If you want your music to be even quieter or louder as a default, let us know.). 

What do you think about this update?

notes.title: Giveaway!
notes.content:
[b]We decided to entertain you, before official release![/b]

We are making some adjustments to the game and game will be published 20.03.2018 at 02:00 pm PDT.

We'll be handing out 7 keys. (7 winners).

Giveaway Competition starts immediately and it ends 20.3.2018 01:45 pm PDT.

[h1]How to join the Giveaway Competition?[/h1]

To join the competition, simply post something to our Community Hub ´Giveaway!´ -sub forum. For example, you can post ideas etc. This sub forum will be deleted after competition. Winners will be informed after competition. 

[b]How will we choose winners?[/b]

Winners will be selected by drawn-system method.

notes.title: Graphical Update [18.3.].
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32270245/0a58d21b63c1c0ef1034c180604d63ff64eb3489.png[/img]

Hi!

While waiting approval for the build from Valve, we have made 'big' update to the game.

[b]This update brings:[/b]
[list]
[*] More realistic grass
[*] Refresh to the menu graphical style
[*] Update to pictures which appear when opposite team or you made a goal
[*] New header image (that desing has been published about week ago)
[/list]

What do you think about this update? Is this new grass better than previous one? Check updated style from video trailer! 

Also we would like to add, that you can now get Seasonal Soccer at a special price! (-40%) This launch discount starts once the game is released on Steam into Early Access. Soooo add the game to your Wishlist to be the first informed!

notes.title: PC-version has been submitted for review
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32270245/5f047506f06cb5bfbbc0d23d324a25293108d252.png[/img]

[h1]The release date is approaching![/h1]

[b]Hi all soccer players![/b]

Sooo is everyone ready fooor release? Then we have good news! We have just submitted PC-version for Valve review today 14.3. [b]Macintosh version will be submitted for review 1-2 weeks after the PC review is accepted because we are still making some adjustements to prepair Mac-version. Not a big issue, but we first want to get review for this PC-version since this order is more easy for us to proceed.[/b] During these first weeks mac version will not appear in the alternative purchase option, but do not worry, we are making Seasonal Soccer to be also available for Mac and it will be available 1-2 weeks after PC-version.

[b]Less than 8 days for PC-version release.. Stay tuned![/b]

Best,
Seasonal Soccer
